title: A possible case of adaptive radiation in cycads. A commentary on ‘Transcriptome sequencing data provide a solid base to understand the phylogenetic relationships, biogeography and reticulated evolution of the genus Zamia L. (Cycadales: Zamiaceae)’
content: This article comments on:Anders Lindstrom, Sadaf Habib, Shanshan Dong, Yiqing Gong, Jian Liu, Michael Calonje, Dennis Stevenson and Shouzhou Zhang, Transcriptome sequencing data provide a solid base to understand the phylogenetic relationships, biogeography and reticulated evolution of the genus Zamia L. (Cycadales: Zamiaceae), Annals of Botany, Volume 134, Issue 5, 1 November 2024, Pages 747–768 https://doi.org/10.1093/aob/mcae065
